title: Raw Torque Data from Collision and Contact Experiments on a KUKA Robot
content: Repository for collision and intentional-contact raw torque signals. It links https://zenodo.org/records/21927431 and https://zenodo.org/records/21941203.

content: Raw joint torque measurements from intentional contacts at 1 kHz.
